verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is a self-hosted gateway, so the operator decides where the proxy and its data run. It also documents multi-region deployment and lets you send logs to storage you choose (GCS, S3, Azure Blob), which together give practical control over where data lives. There is no explicit region-selection or residency-guarantee feature, and multi-region is listed as an enterprise item. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or region-pinning controls, documentation of where cached and spend data is stored, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy) with virtual keys, cost tracking, and an admin UI
Multi-region deployment under one license, admin/worker split
Log Proxy input, output, and exceptions using: Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, GCS, s3, Azure (Blob) Buckets
